newsitem.title: USA: Lason to offer 4.0 mln common shrs.
newsitem.headline: Lason to offer 4.0 mln common shrs.

text.p: Lason Inc said on Monday that it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer 4.0 million common shares.
Of the shares being offered, 1.8 million are being offered by certain stockholders and the remainder will be offered by the company, Lason said in a statement.
Robertson Stephens & Co LLC, William Blair & Co LLC and Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc are the underwriters of the offering, Lason said.
Proceeds to the company will be used to repay indebtedness, it said.
